verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette (cmd+j) can summarize meeting notes, list action items, answer open-ended questions, and let users chat with a filtered subset of notes for grounded Q&A, backed by GPT-4o/Claude choice. Data scope is user-controlled via search filters before chatting, giving some control over what the AI sees. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of AI answer quality, and no dedicated granular privacy/data-access toggle for AI beyond ad-hoc note filtering.
